title: I quit social media from January 1, 2026. Feels good and bad.
discussion_signal: The author describes benefits and costs of quitting, while replies dispute whether Reddit and YouTube count as social media and point to continued platform use as a contradiction or substitution.
linked_research_question: Whether exit is platform-specific substitution rather than complete non-use, and how users define a successful break.
engagement: 86 visible votes in search extract; not population prevalence.
limits: Definitions of social media vary across participants
No verified screen-time or persistence measure
